answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. What survives to the orchard is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Every claim climbs the ripple of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the jetty re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
